description: MCP server for Linkwarden, the self-hosted bookmark manager with page preservation
name: io.github.ni-c/linkwarden-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Linkwarden instance, e.g. https://links.example.net (without /api/v1)
environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_URL

environmentVariables.description: Access token from Settings -> Access Tokens
environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the 11 read tools and no write tools
environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)
environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_ALLOW_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever LINKWARDEN_ALLOW_TOOLS left
environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_DENY_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept self-signed certificates for this connection only
environmentVariables.name: LINKWARDEN_INSECURE_TLS

title: Linkwarden
